# SCI-FRUIT — required conditional predictions r0.4 (amended)

Status: owner-directed Stage A prediction obligations. Authority: repair
direction SCI-FRUIT-OD-STAGE-A-TYPE-METHOD-REPAIR-2026-09-06, section 16,
as repaired by SCI-FRUIT-OD-STAGE-A-MICRO-REPAIR-2026-09-07 and amended by
SCI-FRUIT-OD-STAGE-A-FINAL-AMENDMENT-2026-09-07, sections 1–6.
These are statements to derive and make scientifically falsifiable in Stage B,
not numerical experiments authorized or performed in Stage A. A premise is
not a supplied numerical method. Complete fixed linear conditions mean A_k,
Pi_k and B_k all exact fixed linear on declared spaces, units, support, state
and conditioning in [the response table](RESPONSE_AND_UNCERTAINTY_FAMILIES.md).
The reference m_ref^applied and perturbation delta_m^applied below are in the
same declared applied-model space M_k; neither denotes an accepted model by
implication. Candidate, accepted and applied identities remain separate.
M_k^candidate, M_k^accepted and M_k^applied and all transformations are explicit;
no equal domain, support, unit, normalization, sign, representation, response,
uncertainty or parentage is assumed. Any equality requires an exact method/state fact.

Every additive equality, difference or cancellation below requires compatible
quantity, unit/numerical scale, frame/domain, grid/sampling, support, additive
origin/reference or gauge, null-space state, calibration and response conventions
in exact additive Y_k/Z_k or declared affine/quotient spaces with well-defined
arithmetic. A missing premise makes that claim unavailable; it is not an
implicit zero level or reference alignment. The same reference/gauge/null-space
premises bind each response and uncertainty prediction.

| Prediction ID | Explicit premises | Required consequence or discriminating failure |
| --- | --- | --- |
| SCI-FRUIT-PRED-001 | Zero applied feedback contribution: m_k^applied=0 and Pi_k(0)=B_k(0)=0 on otherwise identical compatible state/support/reference/gauge/null-space state | z_k=F_k(y_k^in), the declared residual-only route. Zero candidate or accepted model does not imply zero applied model; a coordinate zero or unavailable absolute mode is not an observed zero, and zero applied values do not erase offsets in non-zero-preserving maps |
| SCI-FRUIT-PRED-002 | F_k is identity on compatible Y_k=Z_k; Pi_k and B_k are identical removal/rejoin maps acting on m_k^applied; support, additive reference/gauge, null-space state and arithmetic agree | z_k=y_k^in in that exact quantity space. A missing premise blocks cancellation; the equality neither restores an upstream unavailable mode nor assumes accepted/applied equality |
| SCI-FRUIT-PRED-003 | Complete fixed linear conditions and B_k=A_k o Pi_k on M_k | D_k=0 and z_k=A_k y_k^in is independent of the applied model under those fixed conditions |
| SCI-FRUIT-PRED-004 | Exact iteration input y_k^in=Pi_k(m_ref^applied), perfect applied model m_k^applied=m_ref^applied and zero-preserving residual processing in the declared reference/gauge | z_k=B_k(m_ref^applied); nonidentity rejoin implies neither true sky nor unit response. Rejoined content in an upstream unavailable additive mode remains model_or_prior_supported. A perfect accepted model alone does not establish the applied-model premise |
| SCI-FRUIT-PRED-005 | Complete fixed linear conditions, same y_k^in and operators, m_k^applied=m_ref^applied+delta_m^applied | Applied-model-induced error relative to the same procedure with m_ref^applied is D_k delta_m^applied; its conditional mean is the corresponding bias component, not all sky bias or an untransformed accepted-model error |
| SCI-FRUIT-PRED-006 | Inherited ordinary PTC fixed-subspace/recomputed-coefficient application versus separately named frozen-component subtraction | Their rules and responses differ; incidental equality does not make them interchangeable. One unchanged recomputation method keeps its identity across new coefficient/application states |
| SCI-FRUIT-PRED-007 | Method explicitly permits a model-only output occurrence or a declared model contribution in an upstream unavailable additive mode | That content is model_or_prior_supported, not observationally_measured, recovered_from_data, acquired_exposure or unit_response_truth; a reference/gauge choice creates no measurement |
| SCI-FRUIT-PRED-008 | Unequal path support or incompatible removal/rejoin additive-reference/gauge/null-space facts | Follow a permitted support class only with the full declared additive compatibility, or mark the affected composition unavailable; no implicit fill, renormalization, offset or gauge alignment |
| SCI-FRUIT-PRED-009 | Candidate construction, acceptance, application or consequential state depends on data under the exact response catalog | RF-03 includes one iteration's dependence with prior state fixed; RF-04 propagates fixed-sequence dependence; RF-05 includes stop/resource/selection dependence; RF-07 composes the full FRUIT-only parent-domain query. These are not aliases of RF-01/RF-02 or independent duplicates of components |
| SCI-FRUIT-PRED-010 | Query crosses a threshold, support, branch, state or terminal-selection boundary | Derivative may be unavailable; retain the typed discontinuity/state transition. A finite difference requires its own declared convention and compatible reference/gauge/null-space comparison, not substitution of a fixed-branch derivative |
| SCI-FRUIT-PRED-011 | Complete fixed linear conditions and joint covariance of (y_k^in, m_k^applied) under exact additive-reference/gauge/null-space conditioning | All four terms, including both cross terms, remain required; omissions require exact authority. Candidate/accepted covariance cannot replace applied covariance without transformation, and a fixed gauge does not establish measured zero uncertainty in an unavailable mode |
| SCI-FRUIT-PRED-012 | Iterations reuse a parent or shared model/reference information | They do not become independent measurements and imply no 1/sqrt(iteration-count) uncertainty scaling |
| SCI-FRUIT-PRED-013 | Iteration with absolute zero-based index N completed; continuation-sufficient S_(N+1), same future controls and declared method/profile | Continuation begins at absolute index N+1 from S_(N+1) and agrees with uninterrupted execution, including reference/gauge/null-space state; N is an index, not a count, and an omitted consequential state defeats the premise |
| SCI-FRUIT-PRED-014 | Restart or relearning | Restart has a new lineage. Relearning under an unchanged method produces distinct state/application generations and may be part of exact continuation; changing the learning rule requires a new method identity. Method and realized state identities are not aliases |
| SCI-FRUIT-PRED-015 | Iteration/resource maximum reached | This establishes its resource/stop state, not convergence or adequacy |
| SCI-FRUIT-PRED-016 | Terminal rule selects the completed iteration with absolute zero-based index N | Its separate immutable record retains selected identity, complete candidate population, rule/generation, convergence/stop/resource facts, causes, terminal response/uncertainty, continuation/terminality and use-status references or permitted unavailable statuses; the selected bundle is never mutated, relabeled or replaced |
| SCI-FRUIT-PRED-017 | Observation-local versus coadd-level or jointly learned grouping | FRUIT(Coadd(y_o)) and Coadd(FRUIT(y_o)) are not equivalent by implication; any commutation requires exact compatible operators, learning and support premises |
| SCI-FRUIT-PRED-018 | Fixed-state NOI rule versus a per-realization relearning rule | The different rules require separate method/ensemble identities and cannot share one ensemble under this core. Members under one unchanged rule have distinct realized states, not a new method for each member |
| SCI-FRUIT-PRED-019 | No complete, exact owner-approved `FRUIT-FEEDBACK-METHOD/<method-name>@<revision>` record | No numerical FRUIT route or result is admitted; creating the v0.1 authority family or authoring/freezing the conditional core does not approve a method-specific identity |
| SCI-FRUIT-PRED-020 | A FRUIT iteration/terminal bundle satisfies universal core minimum requirements and hard dependencies plus its exact method's requirements | This does not establish Pointing, OOF, source/catalogue admission or production fitness. An absent downstream profile does not erase permitted local completeness, and a method cannot waive core roles to claim it |

Stage B must preserve these IDs, state domains and assumptions, and distinguish
the exact algebraic conclusion from any measurement or performance assertion.
Predictions using zero or identity maps are conditional limiting cases, not
defaults, selected projectors, numerical populations or approved run plans.
